entities.summary: Volodymyr Stanislavovych Ohryzko is a Ukrainian diplomat. He served as the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine from December 18, 2007 to March 3, 2009, when he was fired by the Ukrainian Parliament. On March 17, 2009, Ohryzko was appointed First Deputy Secretary of the National Security and Defense Council by President Viktor Yushchenko.
